name: calc_factorial_gt_div_exp_pow
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n < (n.factorial : ℝ)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n < (n.factorial : ℝ)
informal: n! > (n/e)ⁿ for n ≥ 1 — eⁿ = ∑ nᵏ/k! > nⁿ/n! (a single term of the positive exponential series, Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg / strict since other terms are positive); or induction using (1+1/n)ⁿ < e.
